title: unified-rollouts: integrated canary + shadow autorollback workflow with e2e tests
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds integrated canary+shadow autorollback workflow with E2E tests. No breaking API changes. Improves rollback reliability and observability for staged rollouts.
description: Context: This PR implements an integrated autorollback workflow that unifies canary, A/B and shadow traffic observations into the rollout decision engine. Motivation: previous autorollback logic handled canary and shadow paths separately which resulted in delayed or incorrect rollback decisions during staged/probing rollouts. Design: - Extend the rollout state machine to include a Quarantine stage that temporarily halts weight ramps when transient regressions are observed. - Introduce a Probe Quorum evaluator that aggregates metrics from shadow probes and canary traffic and applies weighted voting (configurable per-rollout). - Add metric matching logic so shadow probe signals with high fidelity (e.g., accuracy/regression signal) can trigger a preemptive quarantine before canary ramp hits a threshold. - Add automatic fallback policies to route traffic to a safe variant when quorum indicates a regression and quarantine fails. - Wire end-to-end sandbox tests that exercise canary ramps, shadow probes, quorum thresholds, and auto-rollback to validate the full flow. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3421) - [x] Unit tests for state machine transitions - [x] Integration tests for quorum evaluator - [x] E2E sandbox tests for staged rollouts and recovery - [x] Observability: new metrics and dashboards - [x] Migration: rollout config defaults preserved - [x] Documentation snippets and API compatibility notes Changes: - rollout engine: consolidated decision path, added Quarantine state and quorum evaluator - controllers: API accepts optional probeQuorum and quarantineDuration fields (backwards compatible defaults) - splitter/traffic router: added temporary quarantine mode to stall weight ramps - metrics: rollout.quarantine_count, rollout.quarantine_duration_ms, rollout.quorum_votes_total, rollout.rollback_triggered - tests: new e2e scenarios under rollouts/sandbox and CI job for sandbox-e2e How this affects deployments: Default behavior is backward compatible. Operators can opt-in to probeQuorum semantics per rollout. Quarantine is conservative by default (short duration and requires 2/3 vote). Rollback behavior: when quorum votes exceed threshold for configured lookback windows we trigger an automatic rollback and mark the rollout as "quarantined" for auditing. Observability: dashboards included in this PR surface per-rollout vote breakdown and per-probe signal histograms. See release notes and console screenshots in the docs folder.

changelog_entry: Integrated canary+shadow autorollback workflow with probe quorum and quarantine stage (safe defaults). Added E2E tests and new rollout metrics.
user_impact: None for users using default rollout configs. Operators who opt-in can expect faster quarantine+rollback on probe-detected regressions.
additional_context: Related work: ENG-3470 adds canary-weight heuristics; ENG-3421 design doc contains threat model and quorum rationale. This PR centralizes decision logic to avoid split failure modes observed in recent incidents (incident-2026-01-18).
